vision.title: Vision
vision.text: Our vision is an education-fair Germany, where all children and young people have access to academic and social education, enabling them to lead a self-determined life.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: As students from all disciplines, we collaboratively and publicly develop independent projects that support children and young people on an equal footing in their academic and social development.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.text: As Sailsetters, we volunteer approximately 20 hours per semester in one or more of our projects.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.text: All Sailsetters receive, in addition to the wealth of experiences and memories they gain during their time at Sailsetters, a certificate for their commitment.

wellenbrecher.title: Project Wellenbrecher
wellenbrecher.subtitle: Creating Perspectives
wellenbrecher.description: This project provides career orientation for middle school students and promotes soft skills through workshops, external visits, and long-term mentoring. We collaborate with academic partners, social organizations, and companies to offer young people diverse insights. The goal is to support especially disadvantaged youth in discovering their talents and shaping their future independently.

uebertrittsnachhilfe.title: Transition Tutoring
uebertrittsnachhilfe.subtitle: Individual tutoring for school transition
uebertrittsnachhilfe.description: The project supports 4th-grade students in achieving the required grades for their desired secondary school. A weekly review session is offered, where key topics are covered and deepened through one-on-one tutoring. Additionally, learning strategies are taught to optimally prepare students for the transition.

projektWochenNaturwissenschaften.title: Science Project Weeks
projektWochenNaturwissenschaften.subtitle: Haus für Kinder Perlach & Lichtblick Hasenbergl
projektWochenNaturwissenschaften.description: Our members prepare scientific experiments for kindergarten children. These experiments are conducted every two weeks with rotating groups of children at our haven, 'Haus für Kinder Perlach.' Through this, we aim to introduce children to science in a playful way at an early age.

kinderuni.title: Children’s University
kinderuni.subtitle: Inspiring Curiosity
kinderuni.description: The Children's University fosters a love of learning among elementary school children through interactive educational units on exciting topics beyond the standard curriculum. In lectures and classroom sessions, children can satisfy their curiosity by asking questions and receiving playful rewards. The goal is to strengthen initiative and a dynamic understanding of education while Sailsetters convey knowledge creatively.

About.title: Who are we?
About.description: We are a group of students from TUM and LMU from various study programs who care deeply about educational equity.

SailsettersDescription.commitment: Get involved in long-term projects, develop your own ideas, and contribute to sustainable change. Connect with experts and experienced members to create impactful projects.
SailsettersDescription.timeInvestment: With about 2-3 hours per week, you can actively participate, take on responsibility, and develop personally – while still having enough time for your studies.
